subject: redis-cli - fix sscanf incorrect return-value check warnings (#13059)
reason: The change only tightens two sscanf return-value checks in redis-cli's matchNoTokenArg, which is used solely to compute the interactive linenoise syntax hint text (hintsCallback). That code runs only in interactive raw-TTY mode; with piped stdin (as in the fuzzer's tools runner) linenoise never invokes the hints callback, so the changed path is unreachable in automated testing.
